role: Artificer

# The avatar is an original hand-drawn SVG shipped inline as a data URI, so

avatar: data:image/svg+xml;base64,
# Contact. The email never renders as a mailto link: it becomes an
# obfuscated "[at] / [dot]" chip that copies the address on click.
email: wren.emberquill@example.com
phone: ""
website: https://example.com
# Social links: only the filled ones render. Empty strings are valid
# and simply hide the icon.
github: https://github.com/example

twitter: ""
scholar: ""
medium: ""
orcid: ""
# Any other platform, one per line: "Label: URL" or "Label [icon]: URL".
# The optional [icon] names a glyph from src/shared/lib/linkIcons.ts; with an
# icon the hero renders an icon square, without one a text chip. A
# mailto link renders as an obfuscated copy-to-clipboard chip instead.
links: |
  Bestiary sketches [camera]: https://example.com/bestiary
  Lecture scrolls: https://example.com/scrolls
  Guild post [at]: mailto:guild@example.com
# Profile details: filled fields render beside the location, empty ones hide.
nationality: Fey-born
availability: Open to quests
workMode: Remote · By raven
dateOfBirth: "" # ISO date; never rendered, but it SHIPS in the public bundle like every
# profile field. Leave empty on public deployments (type it into a resume document instead).
declaration: ""
# One entry per line, "Language: Proficiency". The last line below has no
# colon on purpose: malformed lines render as a bare name instead of
# crashing or disappearing.
languages: |
  Common: Fluent
  Elvish: Conversational
  Draconic
# One category per line, "Category: item1, item2". Category keywords pick

# fallback icon, because categories are open strings.
skills: |
  Software Artifice: Runic Script, Golem Logic, Clockwork Patterns
  Cloud & Sky Magic: Stormbinding, Aether Currents, Skyward Wards
  Data & Lore: Ley-Line Analysis, Knowledge Grimoires

  Wandcraft: Whittling, Core Binding

now: ""
# Markdown, optional: setup and workflow notes shown at the end of /skills.

uses: |
  A demo of the optional setup notes. Markdown works here: **bold**, `code`,
